claim: For the 12-vertex, 30-edge icosahedral graph \(I\), let \(K\) be the simplicial complex of vertex subsets inducing maximum degree at most one (equivalently, \(\operatorname{Ind}_2(I)\), the second independence or dissociation complex). Then \(K\simeq\bigvee^{20}S^3\) integrally. As rational representations of the full graph automorphism group \(\operatorname{Aut}(I)\cong A_5\times C_2\), \(\widetilde H_3(K;\mathbb Q)\cong\mathbf1^+\oplus V_4^+\oplus (V_5^+)^{\oplus2}\oplus V_5^-\), where \(V_4\) and \(V_5\) are the four- and five-dimensional rational irreducibles of \(A_5\) and superscripts record the action of central antipodal inversion. In particular, the antipodally even and odd eigenspaces have dimensions 15 and 5, and exactly one rational third-homology line is fixed by every graph automorphism.
integrity: A standalone Python 3 verifier enumerates all face predicates and Hasse incidences, proves matching acyclicity by complete topological sorting, and computes all 120 automorphism characters. This is self-review only; no external validation is asserted.
limitations: The homotopy classification is nonequivariant and only for the icosahedral graph; the homology character is rational and does not specify an integral equivariant lattice. Unindexed equivalent prior work is possible.
title: The icosahedral dissociation complex: twenty three-spheres and full symmetry
